checks_performed: Read only the specified source input and draft; used no web or other evidentiary files.
Compared the exact unrestricted target against the draft's claimed PARTIAL resolution and final writeup.

Reconstructed the WKE reduction, hereditary induction, locally bipartite specialization, triangle-edge pruning, component additivity, degeneracy implication, and minimal-counterexample argument directly from their definitions.
Persisted and ran an exact exhaustive checker that generated all 4,682,270 labelled triangle-free graphs on eight vertices and literally validated a WKE witness for each.
Used the same checker to verify the explicit nine-vertex C5 blow-up is triangle-free, non-WKE, and has no induced degree-at-most-one subgraph on more than four vertices.
Checked quantifier inheritance, packing compatibility, covering compatibility, K4-freeness of links, deletion invariance, component support disjointness, and the strict mad threshold.

claims.claim: A WKE link gives a self-contained one-vertex reduction.
claims.evidence: Given a WKE witness (M,Q) in G[N(v)], the triangles S={vxy:xy∈M} are edge-disjoint because M is a matching. With X=M∪{vq:q∈Q}, |X|≤2|S| and every triangle through v meets X. For G'=(G−X)−v, S can be combined with every packing of G', while X can be combined with every transversal of G'. Thus ν(G)≥|S|+ν(G') and τ(G)≤|X|+τ(G'), proving the claimed reduction.
claims.search_method: Direct symbolic verification from the WKE, packing, and transversal definitions.
claims.witness: For any WKE pair (M,Q), use S={vxy:xy∈M} and X=M∪{vq:q∈Q}.

claims.claim: Every graph whose every nonempty subgraph has a vertex with WKE link satisfies τ≤2ν.
claims.evidence: Induction on |V(G)| is valid. The WKE reduction leaves a proper subgraph G'. Every nonempty subgraph of G' is also a subgraph of G, so the quantified hypothesis is inherited. Induction proves τ(G')≤2ν(G'), and claim 0 transfers it to G.
claims.search_method: Inductive proof audit with explicit verification of the inherited quantifier.
claims.witness: The induction certificate at each step is the WKE witness of the selected vertex's link.

claims.claim: Every locally bipartite graph satisfies τ≤2ν.
claims.evidence: Local bipartiteness is hereditary: for J⊆G, each J[N_J(v)] is a subgraph of the bipartite graph G[N_G(v)]. By König's theorem, a bipartite link has a matching M and vertex cover Q with |M|=|Q|, hence is WKE. Claim 1 therefore applies to every locally bipartite graph.
claims.search_method: Direct hereditary-property audit plus König's matching-cover theorem.
claims.witness: In each bipartite link, take a maximum matching M and a minimum vertex cover Q of equal cardinality.

claims.claim: Every triangle-free graph on at most eight vertices is WKE.
claims.evidence: The exact checker recursively adjoined every independent neighborhood, thereby generating each labelled triangle-free graph exactly once. It reported n=8 labelled_triangle_free=4682270, non_WKE=0, and PASS. For each graph it constructed (Q,M) and independently checked M⊆E, that M is a matching, |Q|≤|M|, and that Q covers H−M. Every smaller graph can be padded to eight vertices with isolates; deleting those isolates from Q preserves a resulting WKE witness for the original graph.
claims.search_method: Exact exhaustive generation and complete WKE witness search using integer bit masks; no floating point or randomness.
claims.witness: The checker constructs and literally validates a WKE pair (Q,M) for every one of the 4,682,270 generated order-eight graphs.

claims.claim: The order-eight WKE bound is sharp: a triangle-free non-WKE graph exists on nine vertices.
claims.evidence: For the stated C5 blow-up, the checker reported triangle_free=True, WKE=False, max_induced_degree_at_most_one_order=4, and PASS. Deductively, any WKE witness on nine vertices has |Q|≤|M|≤4, so R=V−Q has at least five vertices; since every edge of H[R] must belong to the matching M, H[R] would have maximum degree at most one. The exhaustive maximum of four contradicts this.
claims.search_method: Exact exhaustive search over all Q and matchings, plus all 512 vertex subsets for the induced-degree bound.
claims.witness: Parts A0={0}, A1={1,2}, A2={3,4}, A3={5,6}, A4={7,8}, with every edge between consecutive cyclic parts and no other edges.

claims.claim: Deleting every edge that lies in no triangle preserves both ν and τ.
claims.evidence: The original graph and its triangle-edge subgraph have exactly the same triangle family. Therefore their feasible triangle packings coincide. Any transversal can discard all edges lying in no triangle without losing coverage, so their minimum transversal sizes also coincide.
claims.search_method: Direct comparison of the two graphs' triangle hypergraphs.
claims.witness: The common triangle family itself identifies both packing and covering instances.

claims.claim: Triangle packing and covering are additive over triangle edge-overlap components.
claims.evidence: Two distinct overlap classes have disjoint edge supports; a shared support edge would belong to triangles in both classes and merge them. Optimal packings from all classes may consequently be united. Conversely, every global transversal restricts to a transversal of each disjoint support, while the union of optimal component transversals is global. Hence both optima are sums of their component optima.
claims.search_method: Direct decomposition proof on the triangle hypergraph's edge-connected components.
claims.witness: The component certificate is the partition of all triangles by chains of shared edges.

claims.claim: If the triangle-edge subgraph G△ is K4-free and 8-degenerate, then τ(G)≤2ν(G).
claims.evidence: Every nonempty subgraph J of G△ has a vertex v of degree at most eight. Its link is triangle-free, since a link triangle together with v would form a K4 in J. Claim 3 makes this at-most-eight-vertex link WKE, so claim 1 proves the inequality for G△. Claim 5 transfers the identical ν and τ values back to G.
claims.search_method: Hereditary degeneracy proof combined with the independently checked small-link theorem.
claims.witness: At each recursive stage, choose a current vertex of degree at most eight and use its WKE link certificate.

claims.claim: If G△ is K4-free and mad(G△)<9, then τ(G)≤2ν(G).
claims.evidence: Every nonempty subgraph of G△ has average degree below nine and therefore contains a vertex whose integer degree is at most eight. Thus G△ is 8-degenerate, and claim 7 applies. The strict inequality is used correctly; no conclusion is asserted at mad=9.
claims.witness: For each nonempty subgraph, a vertex of degree no greater than its average supplies the required deletion vertex.

claims.claim: A subgraph-minimal K4-free counterexample would have every edge in a triangle and minimum degree at least nine.
claims.evidence: Deleting an edge in no triangle preserves ν and τ by claim 5 and would give a proper K4-free counterexample, contradicting subgraph-minimality. If d(v)≤8, K4-freeness makes G[N(v)] triangle-free, claim 3 makes it WKE, and claim 0 reduces the inequality to a proper K4-free subgraph, which satisfies it by minimality. Hence every vertex has degree at least nine.
claims.search_method: Minimal-counterexample audit under both edge deletion and WKE vertex reduction.
claims.witness: The two forbidden reductions are deletion of a non-triangle edge and reduction at any vertex of degree at most eight.

claims.claim: The inequality holds componentwise whenever every triangle edge-overlap component has either a locally bipartite structure or a K4-free 8-degenerate structure.
claims.evidence: Claim 2 proves the inequality for every locally bipartite support component, and claim 7 proves it for every K4-free 8-degenerate support component. Claim 6 permits summing the appropriate inequality over the pairwise edge-disjoint triangle-overlap components, yielding the global inequality.
claims.search_method: Componentwise assembly using the two verified class theorems and exact additivity.
claims.witness: For each overlap component, use the certificate from claim 2 or claim 7 according to its stated structure, then take their union.

target_evidence: The exact target asks for the unrestricted inequality for every finite simple graph or an explicit graph violating it. The draft explicitly says the unrestricted conjecture remains unresolved and supplies neither requested endpoint. Its nine-vertex non-WKE graph is triangle-free, so ν=τ=0 and it is not a counterexample. Nevertheless, the verified WKE elimination theorem, locally bipartite theorem, K4-free 8-degenerate theorem, mad<9 corollary, and componentwise extension are correct and material restricted progress. Therefore target coverage is VALID_PARTIAL_PROGRESS. Because claimed_resolution is PARTIAL and the final writeup does not assert universal coverage, that claimed resolution is ACCURATE.
